Author: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>
Date:   Mon Aug 19 08:07:34 2013 +0200

    ipv6: Add support for IPsec virtual tunnel interfaces
    
    This patch adds IPv6  support for IPsec virtual tunnel interfaces
    (vti). IPsec virtual tunnel interfaces provide a routable interface
    for IPsec tunnel endpoints.
    
    Signed-off-by: Steffen Klassert <steffen.klassert@secunet.com>

diff --git a/net/ipv6/ip6_vti.c b/net/ipv6/ip6
bic_trace_step.reason: The vti6_tnl_lookup() function does not contain a loop over wildcard tunnels; it only checks a single fallback tunnel 'tnls_wc[0]' and returns it directly without verifying that its endpoints are wildcards. The root cause describes a vulnerability in a wildcard tunnel search loop that fails to verify endpoint addresses—such a loop is absent in this function. Hence, the vulnerable construct is not present.
